messages:
Maya: ok team, pet photo drop time! meet Maizey, my corgi-beagle rescue. full loaf energy. https://photos.redwood.com/maizey-hoodie.jpg :heart_eyes:
Devon: omg the ears :laughing: what's the story on the hoodie?
Maya: thrifted, bribed with turkey to get it on. works every time.
Luis: dropping a :paw_print: for Maizey. also love a good loaf.
Jamie: random q — who actually brings pets to the office vs remote-only pet pics? react with :house: for remote, :office: for bring-to-office occasionally.
Maya: :office: Fridays!
Devon: :house: but I photobomb calls with my cat sometimes.
Luis: :house: remote, but my dog does have a standing desk setup in spirit.
ops-bot: Reminder: office pet policy v2 is live — all animals on-site must have updated vaccinations and owner sign-off. See https://intranet.redwood/pet-policy.
Maya: noted, already uploaded Maizey's vax card to HR.
Devon: can we do a low-key 'pet spotlight' next week? quick 1-min intro.
Jamie: yes please — tagging @people-ops to coordinate.
Maya: happy to bring Maizey on Friday for a 1-min cameo. she only sits for snacks.
Luis: [upload] tiny-maizey-hop.mp4 — 4MB, cutest hop.
Devon: saving for my wallpaper.
Maya: pro tip: when doing action shots, set camera to burst. also bribery again.
Jamie: vote: who wants to see a weekly pet channel thread? :ballot_box_with_ballot:
Devon: vote in.
Luis: yes.
Maya: 100% yes.
ops-bot: FYI — new pinned message in #random with pet policy and upload guidelines.
Maya: thanks bot :pray:
Devon: Maizey says thank you and demands more treats. :dog:
